name: perhr
description: Log your Claude Code sessions in per.hr: your time, agent time, compute and what shipped, matched to the client, project and Plan item. Only repos you connect in per.hr are recorded; prompts and code are never sent.

api_key.title: per.hr key
api_key.description: From per.hr: Configure → Data → Claude Code → Create a Key. Or leave this empty and save the key in ~/.perhr/key.

folder_only.title: Record by folder name only
folder_only.description: Send only each repo's folder name to per.hr, never its remote address (host, owner and repo name). Repos then appear in per.hr by folder name; match them to projects again after turning this on. Or create the file ~/.perhr/folder-only.
